channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Tickets on sale for 2nd Southern Nash HOF ceremony March 28
item.description: Tickets are on sale for Southern Nash High’s second Athletic Hall of Fame induction March 28 at 6 p.m., honoring eight former student-athletes across four decades; $50 with dinner at gofan.co.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 7-8, 2026
item.description: Full weekend sports slate Feb. 7–8: Barton College hosts and travels for basketball, softball, baseball, bowling, lacrosse, tennis and track, plus area high school hoops.

item.title: Bulldogs drop season opener 11-8 at Newberry
item.description: Barton’s ninth-inning rally falls short in an 11-8 season-opening loss at Newberry, spoiling new head coach Matt Padgett’s debut despite the Bulldogs’ 10 hits.

item.title: NCHSAA Basketball Glance, Feb. 7, 2026
item.description: Standings, rankings and upcoming games for NCHSAA Big East, Eastern Plains, Eastern Carolina and Three Rivers basketball heading into the week of Feb. 7, 2026.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Tigers take care of Jaguars to retain share of ECAC lead
item.description: Wilson Prep boys keep ECAC lead share with rout of Rocky Mount Prep as Tigers girls notch 15th straight; Community Christian celebrates boys Senior Night win while girls fall to Greenville Christian.

item.title: Lady Chargers’ lockdown D leads to 2 wins
item.description: Wilson Christian’s girls locked down Southside Christian 43-6 and Bethel Christian 31-7, securing the District 3 top seed at 18-7 overall on a senior night spotlighting Lilly Hoskins and Emily Moore.

item.title: Balanced attack effective for WCA boys over Bethel
item.description: Four Chargers in double figures powered Wilson Christian’s varsity boys to a 64-42 win over Bethel, snapping a five-game skid and pulling WCA into a tie atop NCCSA 2-A East District 3.

item.title: Bruins offense lights up but not enough to beat Vikings
item.description: Beddingfield’s offense surges but defense falters in a 77-63 home loss to Tarboro, the Bruins’ ninth straight defeat despite 19 points from freshman JamaJay Ward.

item.title: Beddingfield crunches Tarboro 53-13 behind Coppedge
item.description: Sa’Naiya Coppedge’s double-double powers Beddingfield girls past Tarboro 53-13 for first win in two weeks, keeping the Bruins in the NCHSAA 3-A playoff hunt.

item.title: Edwards sparks Knights past Chargers to perfect CPIC finish
item.description: Kobe Edwards’ 23 points and Greenfield’s pressure defense fuel a 68-53 win over Wayne Country Day, sealing an 8-0 CPIC regular season and a 24-4 overall record for the Knights.
